summary: Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release of its Q1 2026 unaudited results. The filing reports revenue of $110.5M (up 20% YoY), GAAP operating income of $4.4M vs. a loss, and Adjusted EBITDA of $15.1M (doubled). The CEO reaffirms full-year 2026 guidance and notes active evaluation of strategic opportunities. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special-situation event is announced. This is a routine earnings release with no change-of-control or corporate action. A non-US issuer, this 6-K is equivalent to an 8-K earnings press release.
